title: HYROX PRO – Base Builder
notes: Abschrift aus der App HYROX PRO (Testdaten). Inhalte auf Englisch wie im Original, Gewichte zusätzlich in kg.

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: 30 minute max distance test
blocks.details: • record how far you run
blocks.coachNotes:
*This is all about bringing the heart rate down and flushing the legs out to enhance your recovery time. It is best to negative split this run, don't have fast miles in the beginning then have sloppy miles at the end.
*This is a very important test. Do your best, there is no perfect score. This is a baseline test. Wear a heart rate monitor if you can. You can do this on your treadmill, however if you do you must retest on a treadmill too.

sessions.title: 30 minute easy run or 60 minute hike

blocks.name: 30 minute easy run or 60 minute hike
blocks.coachNotes:
*Make the choice based off how you feel from the hard effort from yesterday. Some of you will have harder times recovering from speed work, ideally we want to spend more time running but it is more important to stay healthy and strong during your training.
*The bike is great if you need more recovery time.

blocks.label: P1
blocks.name: Take 15 minutes to find your 3 rep max deadlift
blocks.coachNotes: *This is to find you max strength. Be smart and safe with this test. Remember you aren't a powerlifter, you are an athlete.

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: wall balls
blocks.details:
• 100 wall balls for time - 20lbs (9,1 kg) men | 14lbs (6,4 kg) women
• Rest 5-8 minutes after this

blocks.label: P3
blocks.name: 5k ski or row test
blocks.details:
• I would prefer using the ski erg but if you only have access to a rower this will do.
• Warm up the body for 5-10 minutes with an easy row before you start the test. This is a muscular endurance test. Very different from your run test but just as hard, make sure to fuel properly before this.

sessions.title: 30 minute easy run or 60 minute hike

blocks.name: 30 minute easy run or 60 minute hike
blocks.details:
• Make the choice based off how you feel from the hard effort from yesterday
• Go very easy on this

blocks.label: P1
blocks.name: take 15 minutes to find your 3 rep max bench press
blocks.details: • This is to find you max strength

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: Max strict pull up test- 2 minutes
blocks.details:
• Take as many breaks as possible. This is a strength endurance test, No kipping and no dropping from the top. Chin over the bar at the top, full arm extension at the bottom.
• The goal is to test muscular pull stamina. Get good reps in, don't cheat to get a fake high score.
• Rest 5 minutes after this

blocks.label: P3
blocks.name: 100m walking lunge test
blocks.details:
• 65 lbs (29,5 kg) men | 45 lbs (20,4 kg) women on back
• Knee must touch the ground, fully stand at the top of each rep.

blocks.label: P4
blocks.name: 5 minute max rep bar facing burpee test
blocks.details:
• Each burpee must be to the floor and you must be fully facing the barbell each rep. At the top of each rep you must jump fully over the bar to the other side.
• The plate must have a 45lb (20,4 kg) plate on each side to create specific height for the jump performed in each rep.

sessions.title: Go for a 90 minute hike or bike ride

blocks.name: Go for a 90 minute hike or bike ride
blocks.details:
• This effort is here to build endurance. Since we had a heavy test week we want to keep the intensity very low to make sure that you are fully recovered for next week's training.
• Keep your RPE or heart rate below 70% effort level. This will become a key session each week for you to build the endurance needed for race day.

blocks.name: 60 - minute walk or hike
blocks.details:
• Walking helps burn fat and recover the body for further training.
• Walking can burn upwards of 350 calories an hour, almost purely from body fat. Doing this daily for a month will burn 10,500 calories or 3 lbs of fat. Don't skip your walks :)

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: superset strength session
blocks.details:
2 rounds of 3 reps/2 reps/1 rep
• Front squat
• bench press
blocks.coachNotes:
**How to complete: Make sure you're warmed up. Three sets TOTAL, first set is 3 reps of front squat, 3 reps of bench. Second set is 2 reps each. Third set is 1 rep each.
**Superset each movement, rest after both movements are done. 2-3 minutes best between set.
**Increase the weight each set until you hit a heavy one rep. This last rep should feel like you could hit a max effort triple at this weight

blocks.coachNotes: This is a serious thigh burner! Your goal is to go unbroken on the wall balls, vary the intensity on the bike based on how fit you feel.

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: DON'T GIVE UP
blocks.details:
20 minute EMOM (every minute on the minute)
• Minute 1: 22 cal men | 18 cal women Ski Erg
• Minute 2: 22 cal men | 18 cal women bike
blocks.coachNotes:
10 rounds total
Scale as needed. You should only have 5-10s rest each round while going near max effort pace. This is one of the harder lactic acid type workouts. You should feel the burn starting around minute 5, your goal is to hold on for the next 15 minutes
